name: anchor: cursor searches — organizations & members
description: Copy of "anchor: cursor searches — organizations & members" that sends resource_type when it creates a role or permission. It replaces the original once ADR-0022 PR 1 is deployed. Cursor walks (limit 2) inside a throwaway product: five organizations with one name (default created_at order and sort_by name, all tie), and in organization 1 three workspaces, three members, three invitations (organization and product searches), three API keys, plus the three organizations of one product user. Each walk must return the reference page's rows in order, once each, with next_cursor until the last page. Organizations assert the 400 INVALID_CURSOR refusals (malformed, with offset, other sort_by). Deleting the product (always) removes everything; its 404 is verified.
